summary: This is a Foreign Private Issuer Form 6-K filing by Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S., reporting the results of its Annual General Assembly held on May 7, 2026. The assembly approved 2025 financial statements, the sustainability report, release of board members from liability, a 2026 donation limit, board compensation, reappointment of PwC as independent auditor, and a cash dividend of TRY 8,800,000,000 (TRY 4.00 gross per share, TRY 3.40 net per share) payable on December 9, 2026. This is a routine shareholder meeting outcome, not a special situation.
